description: Land Acquisition - Mulatiyana and Neralampitiya, Mulatiyana D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific lands being acquired (including lot numbers, names, descriptions, claimants, and extents), specifies the public purpose for acquisition, and outlines procedures for interested parties to claim compensation. The content focuses solely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
